description: Ask Dock to raise an org limit (agents, workspaces, rows, or other). We record the signal on the admin side; there's no reply loop. Use this whenever you hit one of those caps. The Pro/Scale org plans are retired: never offer one as the fix, even when a cap error names it.

desiredValue.description: Optional: the specific limit you'd like

reason.description: Optional: 1-2 sentences on the use case
